news.headline: uniQure Shares Fade After AMT-130 Filing, But William Blair Sees 58% Upside
news.summary: QURE shares opened up roughly 6% but closed down about 3% the day the BLA was filed, a 'sell the news' reaction after months of anticipation. William Blair resumed coverage with an Outperform rating and a $73 fair value estimate, calling AMT-130 a potential first disease-modifying therapy for Huntington's as early as H1 2027.

news.headline: uniQure Filed for Huntington's Approval; Acceptance Is the Next Catalyst, Analyst Says
news.summary: Following the BLA submission, analysts framed FDA acceptance of the filing (and a decision on the requested priority review) as the next de-risking catalyst for the stock. uniQure has requested priority review, which if granted would shorten the FDA review clock to six months after the standard 60-day filing review period.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Submission of BLA for AMT-130 (Ifezuntirgene Inilparvovec) in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease, and simultaneously submitted a Marketing Authorisation Application to the UK's MHRA. The filings are supported by the previously reported three-year Phase I/II data showing a statistically significant slowing of disease progression versus an external control from the Enroll-HD database.

news.headline: uniQure Submits BLA for Gene Therapy in Huntington Disease
news.summary: Trade press coverage of the filing noted AMT-130 (an AAV5-delivered miQURE-technology gene therapy silencing the huntingtin gene) would, if approved, be the first disease-modifying treatment for Huntington's disease. The company also said it plans to present a four-year data analysis from the ongoing Phase I/II studies before the end of Q3 2026.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on QURE from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, following the company's Q2 2026 results and confirmation of FDA alignment on the accelerated-approval BLA pathway for AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported that final FDA meeting minutes confirmed alignment on submitting the AMT-130 BLA under the accelerated approval pathway using three-year data, and disclosed $810.3 million in cash and investments as of June 30, 2026, sufficient to fund operations into 2030. The company also flagged early Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) data, with further updates on both programs expected in H1 2027.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data analysis
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present a four-year follow-up data analysis (safety, tolerability and efficacy) from the ongoing Phase I/II studies of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, building on the three-year data used in the BLA.

catalysts.label: FDA decision on BLA filing acceptance / priority review
catalysts.detail: The FDA is expected to complete its standard 60-day review of whether to formally accept the AMT-130 BLA for filing and to rule on uniQure's request for priority review, which would shorten the subsequent review clock to six months.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If priority review is granted, an FDA decision on accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease could arrive roughly six months after the 60-day filing review concludes.

catalysts.label: FDA feedback on confirmatory Phase 3 trial design
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to finalize discussions with the FDA on the design (including use of a concurrent standard-of-care control instead of sham surgery) and statistical analysis plan for the required post-approval confirmatory study.

catalysts.label: MHRA decision on UK Marketing Authorisation Application
catalysts.detail: The UK's MHRA is reviewing uniQure's MAA for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) in Huntington's disease, submitted alongside the FDA BLA.

catalysts.label: Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) clinical updates
catalysts.detail: Company guidance from Q2 2026 results points to further clinical data updates for the AMT-191 Fabry disease program (currently paused in mid/high-dose cohorts pending an FDA-agreed monitoring plan after Grade 3 liver enzyme elevations) and the AMT-260 refractory epilepsy program.

pulse: uniQure hit its biggest milestone yet on September 2, 2026, formally submitting the AMT-130 Biologics License Application to the FDA (with a parallel MHRA filing in the UK) for accelerated approval in Huntington's disease, using three-year Phase I/II data showing a slowing of disease progression versus external control; the company has requested priority review. The stock's reaction was muted ('sell the news') even as William Blair, Wells Fargo and other analysts reiterated bullish targets ($73-$75+) citing a substantially de-risked regulatory path, and the company enters the review period well capitalized with $810 million in cash extending its runway into 2030. Next catalysts are the FDA's filing-acceptance/priority-review decision (~60 days out), a four-year AMT-130 data update expected before quarter-end, and continued progress on the hemophilia B franchise (HEMGENIX, commercialized by CSL Behring) plus the earlier-stage Fabry and epilepsy gene therapy programs.
